title: Concept: Published dependency replaced by a local project at build time
description: settings.gradle declares a dependency substitution that swaps a published module for a local project, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads a dependency substitution that swaps a published module for a local project.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through settings.gradle (gradle).
risk: A dependency resolved from a local path or a mutable branch is not the published artifact the rest of the project audits. This rule reads a dependency substitution that swaps a published module for a local project.
